title: Copy/paste is a second-class citizen: fixed-offset paste, no cut/duplicate, and container subtrees don't duplicate cleanly
existing_state: Paste always lands at the ORIGINAL node position +30/+30 (FlowCanvas/src/utils/clipboard.ts:48-56) — copy a block, scroll to the other end of a long preset, Ctrl+V, and the paste appears off-screen back where the source was. Only Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V exist (hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:48-74); there is no Ctrl+X cut or Ctrl+D duplicate-in-place. The deep copy keeps data.props untouched (clipboard.ts:44-57), so a copied container child still carries _isChildOf/_stepPath/_membershipFromConnect pointing at the ORIGINAL container — branch bands, the layout tree, and export-regeneration then treat the pasted copy as a member of the original's branch, so duplicating an If with its children does not produce an independent subtree. The module-level clipboard (clipboard.ts:9) also survives preset switches, so paste can inject nodes whose metadata references ids from a different preset.
recommendation: Track the last pointer position (or use ReactFlow screenToFlowPosition of the viewport center) and paste there. In pasteNodes, sanitize props: drop _membershipFromConnect/_branchLabel/_branchColor/_forceGraphExport always; remap _isChildOf through idMap when the parent was copied too, else strip _isChildOf/_stepPath so the paste is a clean orphan ready to wire. Add Ctrl+X (copy + removeNodes) and Ctrl+D (copy+paste near selection in one snapshot). Clear the clipboard in the load-graph handler (stores/messageBridge.ts resetGraphSessionState) to stop cross-preset id leakage.
user_benefit: Duplicating a worked-out If/Try pattern — the most common way power users build the next section of a 200-host script — becomes a one-keystroke, lands-where-you-look operation instead of producing a half-linked copy you must hunt down and untangle.

evidence.note: module-level clipboard; paste at source position +30/+30; data.props (incl. _isChildOf/_stepPath) copied verbatim, never sanitized or remapped
only Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V wired; no cut, no duplicate
membership is read from data.props — stale copied metadata is honored by bands/layout/export
